source.text:
11 April 2026
Kestrel Plumbing & Heating Ltd
Our reference: JE224447

Dear R Duffy,

Enclosed is our invoice for boiler servicing at 1 Naylor Ranch. The total shown opposite is expected by the date shown beside it.

Due date              Sub total     £113.92
8 May 2026            VAT           £22.79
                      Total         £136.71

Invoice number JE224447. Tax point 11 April 2026. VAT is charged at the standard rate of 20% and our VAT registration number is shown at the foot of this page.

Please quote the invoice number if you need to contact us. Payment can be made by bank transfer to sort code 56-92-45, account 93752654, using the invoice number as the reference.

Thank you for your business.

Yours sincerely,
Graham Richardson
Kestrel Plumbing & Heating Ltd
